files.document_title: Notice of filing of the Letter of Notification of Will-Power Pipeline OH, LLC for the Aristotle South Pipeline Project, Ohio Power Siting Board case 25-0561-GA-BLN, forwarded to Etna Township 2025-07-09 (law firm email dated 2025-06-24)
files.what_it_shows: A two-page email notice with no map. It states the project is about 17.9 miles of 24-inch high-pressure steel gas pipeline from the planned Socrates South power plant in New Albany, Licking County, to an interconnect with Eastern Gas Transmission and Storage in Liberty Township, Fairfield County. The Letter of Notification was filed 2025-06-23.

searched: The Etna Township notice (seed), downloaded and read
Williams Socrates project page, which lists the Ohio Power Siting Board cases with links (case 25-0561-GA-BLN for Aristotle South)
Wayback availability and CDX index for that case: nothing usable
Two general web searches for the letter of notification and any route map hosted elsewhere: no map found
The Williams Socrates generation facilities map PDF: shows only the two power plant sites in Licking County, no pipelines
notes: No map was found, so the oilandgaswatch geometry stays the only route. Both endpoints are named: the Socrates South plant site in New Albany and an interconnect with Eastern Gas Transmission and Storage in Liberty Township, Fairfield County. The notice confirms the 17.9 mile length and gives a 24-inch diameter. The oilandgaswatch record lists this line as operating while the sheet says proposed, which is worth a check. Baird can compare the oilandgaswatch line against these two endpoints. The Ohio Power Siting Board docket system (dis.puc.state.oh.us) rejects automated requests: case pages return a Request Rejected page through curl and through the repo fetch ladder including the Chrome route, and document pages sit behind a reCAPTCHA check. Wayback availability calls were rate limited and a CDX index query for the 2025 case numbers returned nothing usable.
